title: Restore Complete Suite of 11 Studio Sections with Framer Motion Fluid Animations and Spatial Designer Containers
description: Per user feedback ('where is rest of the sections. its too less now.'), restored the complete, rich, multi-disciplinary studio homepage experience on `app/page.tsx` across all 11 core sections plus sticky header and footer, elevated with Framer Motion fluid scroll-entry animations (fadeUp variants, whileInView with viewport margin), AnimatePresence crossfade & scale on the Hero Carousel, and spatial designer drop zones. The full restored section hierarchy includes: 1. SiteHeader (sticky header with 6-vertical mega-menu, search, cart, theme toggle); 2. HeroCarousel (elevated with Framer Motion AnimatePresence crossfade & subtle scale, autoplay with hover pause, indicator dots, and 16:9 full-bleed spatial designer drop zones); 3. CustomFrameStudio (interactive live frame & canvas switcher island with 5 mouldings, 3 mats, live pricing, studio/room context toggle, and 4 trust highlights); 4. CategoryPills (6 Core Service Verticals discovery navigator with audience tags B2C, B2B, Commercial, Corporate, Public Sector); 5. TrustBar (4 Studio Capabilities: In-House CNC Fabrication, Museum Archival Standards, Turnkey Execution, GeM/Tender Scale); 6. CuratedCollections (curated projects & capabilities grid with 6 vertical filter tabs, in-situ hover cards, and Quick Customise modal); 7. FeaturedProductsCarousel (pure image-based 8-product carousel with Apple-style blurred navigation buttons, dot pagination, and mobile touch swipe); 8. Featured Product & Capability Highlight (designer spatial container section with 2-column layout: left aspect-square floating frame drop zone with dashed border, right title graphic, details box, and CTA button); 9. FramingJourney (4-stage end-to-end studio execution workflow with fluid motion cards); 10. CustomerLookbook (real-world client installations with interactive hotspot pins across Tech Enterprise HQ, Contemporary Collector Residence, and Municipal City Hall); 11. FAQSection (Radix accordion FAQ covering B2C custom framing, B2B commercial spatial design, CNC tolerances, GeM tenders, and corporate gifting); 12. SiteFooter (4-column studio footer with FSC, ISO, GeM certifications). Full test suite passes 100% (43/43 tests) and Next.js Turbopack build succeeds with 0 errors.
